svg.title: Thirty Days to a Counsel-Ready Research Operation
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-thirty-day-operating-sprint; chart type: timeline_roadmap; title: Thirty Days to a Counsel-Ready Research Operation; subtitle: Build a defensible paid-support capability, not a rushed complaint; chapter number: 12; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Numeric values are milestone end days. This sprint establishes operating readiness; it does not shorten the 4–12 month first-deal window or the illustrative 2–5+ year award horizon. FCA investigations may remain under extended seal for years; SEC and IRS submissions do not use the FCA complaint-seal procedure.; caption: Exit the sprint with one reproducible research package, a counsel-reviewed service scope, and a collection-aware cash plan. Recurring support revenue funds operations. Model every pending award as zero cash and stress a permanent zero-recovery outcome before adding fixed costs.; stages: label: Days 1–7; value: Milestone 1: establish scope and source controls; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Choose one niche and define a lawful data inventory. Create source hashes, access permissions, entity resolution rules, and a register of disclosure dates. Draft specific analytical service deliverables.; label: Days 8–14; value: Milestone 2: reproduce and challenge one signal; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Build a small SQLite evidence store and deterministic transforms. Test one anomaly against matched peers and benign explanations. Preserve failed hypotheses and document missing claim-level evidence.; label: Days 15–21; value: Milestone 3: obtain counsel-directed evidence assessment; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Arrange confidential counsel assessment of conflicts, public disclosure, eligibility, particularity, and handling restrictions. Define paid support scope; do not circulate sealed or restricted material as a marketing sample.; label: Days 22–30; value: Milestone 4: prepare delivery and cash controls; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Finalize exhibit lineage, acceptance criteria, invoice milestones, and access logs. Build a 13-week cash forecast with zero award receipts and delayed retainer collections. Scale outreach using sanitized methods demonstrations, not allegations.

rect.title: label: Days 1–7; value: Milestone 1: establish scope and source controls; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Choose one niche and define a lawful data inventory. Create source hashes, access permissions, entity resolution rules, and a register of disclosure dates. Draft specific analytical service deliverables.

text.title: Milestone 1: establish scope and source controls

rect.title: label: Days 8–14; value: Milestone 2: reproduce and challenge one signal; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Build a small SQLite evidence store and deterministic transforms. Test one anomaly against matched peers and benign explanations. Preserve failed hypotheses and document missing claim-level evidence.

text.title: Milestone 2: reproduce and challenge one signal

rect.title: label: Days 15–21; value: Milestone 3: obtain counsel-directed evidence assessment; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Arrange confidential counsel assessment of conflicts, public disclosure, eligibility, particularity, and handling restrictions. Define paid support scope; do not circulate sealed or restricted material as a marketing sample.

label: Days 22–30; value: Milestone 4: prepare delivery and cash controls; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Finalize exhibit lineage, acceptance criteria, invoice milestones, and access logs. Build a 13-week cash forecast with zero award receipts and delayed retainer collections. Scale outreach using sanitized methods demonstrations, not allegations.

text.title: Milestone 4: prepare delivery and cash controls
